content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-311. - Imposition and rate of tax.
content.summary:
On and after July 1, 1985, there is hereby imposed and shall be paid and collected,
               an excise tax of four percent on the price to gain admission or access to any place
               or event in the city that is open to the public.
(Code 1981, § 31-130; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002;…
